local.description: Existing local or headless execution without a sandbox backend

apple-container.description: Apple container CLI on Apple silicon with macOS 26 or newer

unsupported.snapshot: Filesystem exports can contain workload-created secrets; no redaction-safe snapshot contract is verified
unsupported.storage_quota: The inspected CLI exposes isolated sparse filesystems but no per-container hard storage quota
unsupported.secret_injection: Secrets must be supplied by an approved out-of-band broker, never image, argv, environment, receipt, or snapshot

firecracker.description: Linux KVM microVM candidate; host probe only until guest workspace, command transport, and jailed lifecycle are verified

unsupported.execution: The current contract requires an existing linked worktree at /workspace and bounded guest argv execution; Firecracker block devices and vsock do not provide either automatically
unsupported.lifecycle: No jailer, guest agent, private networking, rootfs provisioning, lease reconciliation, or cleanup adapter has been verified
unsupported.snapshot: No redaction-safe guest disk and memory snapshot contract has been verified

evidence.finding: Firecracker requires Linux KVM; the OrbStack Alpine probe lacked /dev/kvm. A ready host is not evidence of a safe sandbox lifecycle

bubbles.description: Gonicus Bubbles desktop environments; no stable external lifecycle CLI was verified

evidence.finding: The primary README documents Flatpak GUI lifecycle controls, not a supported non-interactive orchestration API

cloudron.description: aidevops Cloudron remote worker foundation, not a per-agent sandbox host

evidence.finding: Cloudron exposes authenticated worker dispatch and process management inside one app container; it does not expose per-agent VM lifecycle or host privileges
